name: Enbi-fuku Kamen
source:
[url=/c64092]Mesu-dorei A-ko's[/url] master. He takes the role of trainer to the magical girls and partner to Mesu-dorei A-ko. Has sex with A-ko on several occasions throughout the story.

[spoiler]He is also [url=/c64091]Masaharu[/url] and [url=/c45011]Mami's[/url] father but never bothers to tell Masaharu. Is okay with A-ko having sex with Masaharu.[/spoiler]
